Crichton won an open two miles walking handicap at Guildford and on June 9th, E Stringer was second in a similar event at Wadham Lodge Sports. Purdy flattered to deceive at the beginning of the season and has not yet done what his friends have hoped.

The Club handicaps were keenly contested and showed a vast amount of maturing talent. Purdy was successful in the "100" in a close finish, and another very close finish in the half-mile gave Tom Pritchard a win from A.
Hampson ran the half-mile stage for us and handed over with a fair lead. This was increased by Purdy and retained by J.
High Jump: 3rd, Purdy, 4 ft. 9 ins. Weight: 1st, Sutton, 37 ft. 1½ ins.; 4th, Bateman, 28 ft. 9 ins.

Bob Cooper, who won our first Junior High Jump championship, will be a Senior, but Jim Purdy and one or two others show great promise. Whilst mentioning this championship—support for it was very poor.

Bergvalds also set up a new club record in the Discus Throw and again in the Weight and he is a most consistent performer and deserves his successes. Jim Purdy in the junior High Jump set up new figures and Doug.
